categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Hoperun Software Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: Financial Technology, Intelligent IoT (Internet of Things), and Smart Energy Informatization. Additionally, it has a smaller segment in Intelligent Supply Chain Informatization. The company provides software products, solutions, and comprehensive services across these sectors, focusing on digital transformation and intelligent upgrades for industry clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including domestic operating systems (OpenHarmony and openEuler), AI large models, AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things), and the proprietary NearLink (StarLink) wireless short-range communication technology. It develops integrated software and hardware solutions, emphasizing open-source platforms, AI full-stack capabilities, distributed systems, and cloud-edge-end collaboration. R&D focuses on AI platforms, financial AI testing, distributed collaborative operating systems, and RISC-V based intelligent terminals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include financial institutions such as major state-owned banks, joint-stock banks, insurance companies, and securities firms. Other important markets are the energy sector (power generation, grid companies, new energy enterprises), industrial manufacturing, healthcare, education, and smart city projects. The company serves both domestic and international clients, with a strong presence in China and branches in Japan, the USA, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with offices and R&D centers in over 22 major domestic cities including Nanjing, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. It also has overseas subsidiaries and branches in Japan (Tokyo), the United States (Boston), Singapore, and other locations, supporting a global customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Hoperun Software is positioned primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and IT services supply chain. It develops core software platforms, integrated solutions, and provides technical services and system integration for end customers, especially in financial and industrial sectors. It also collaborates closely with hardware manufacturers and chip providers to ensure ecosystem compatibility.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation in domestic software ecosystems, AI technology integration, and digital transformation enablement. Key R&D directions include advancing OpenHarmony and openEuler operating systems, AI large model platforms (AIRUNS), financial AI testing platforms, distributed collaborative operating systems, and RISC-V based intelligent terminals. It emphasizes open-source community contributions and ecosystem co-construction, aiming to lead in domestic software autonomy and intelligent industry solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product and solution sales, engineering project delivery, and comprehensive technical services. The company offers software licenses, customized development, system integration, cloud services, and ongoing maintenance and consulting. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Sales are predominantly direct to enterprise customers, with a growing share from innovative AI and open-source platform products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Hoperun Software is a leading domestic player in China's software and IT services industry, especially in financial IT solutions and AI integration. It ranks among the top in the Chinese banking IT solutions market and is recognized as a core force in financial IT by IDC. The company maintains competitive advantages through its comprehensive technology stack, early entry into open-source ecosystems, and strong industry partnerships. Major competitors include other domestic software and IT service providers focusing on financial technology and digital transformation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.4 billion, representing a 9.43% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 161 million, slightly down by 1.64%. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 5.37 billion, growing 6.19% year-over-year. R&D investment remains significant, accounting for over 10% of revenue, supporting steady growth and innovation. The company has a workforce exceeding 14,000 employees globally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its role as a leader in domestic digital intelligence technology and service innovation, focusing on indigenous software autonomy, AI-driven intelligent solutions, and integrated software-hardware platforms. Its differentiation lies in deep industry expertise, comprehensive full-stack technology capabilities, strong open-source ecosystem contributions, and tailored solutions for high-barrier sectors like finance and energy. It offers customers enhanced security, reliability, and efficiency through proprietary AI models, distributed systems, and innovative wireless communication technologies.
